summary: Match tokens to unlock incredible riches in The Treasures of Montezuma 3!
description:
The Treasures of Montezuma 3 is a must-have game for all match-three fans!

Get ready for an incredible fairytale adventure in the mystery exciting world of Aztecs and fall in love with these ancient mystic places of America!

Welcome to the match 3 world of your imagination – discover this unique game located at the junction of genres: "match-3" and "Time manager"! Beautiful locations, amazing match-3 gameplay, funny puzzles, RPG elements, and many other interesting things you may find in this match-three game!

The Magic Totems make a return, allowing players to pull off insane combos. By using the awesome powers of the totems strategically, you can score high enough to earn and collect the Magic Stars you need to upgrade your bonus items to the max!

With over 200 levels, amazing visual effects, explosive audio, and stunning backgrounds that shatter the boundaries of art in casual games.

The Treasures of Montezuma 3 will challenge your skills as you try to rack up as many points as possible in one minute, so it's a good way to train concentration and improve your focus! 

Don't miss out on playing the most spectacular, wonderful match-three game in the award-winning The Treasures Of Montezuma series!

GAME FEATURES:
◇ 160 arcade levels
◇ 42 mind-melting puzzle levels
◇ Casual and Expert modes
◇ Five treasure rooms
◇ 40 mystery treasure chests with gold Stars!
◇ 22 trophies to grab
◇ Stunning visual effects
◇ Incredible sound effects
◇ Play on all kinds of mobile phones or tablets
◇ Improve your concentration and focus
◇ Play without WI-Fi, no internet connection required Internet - the game will always be with you!
◇ Game for all!
◇ Easy to play, hard to master
◇ Supported languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Portuguese, Swedish, Netherlands.

Play with friends in the best games from Alawar, creators of such games as Beholder, Farm Frenzy, The Treasures of Montezuma, House of 1000 Doors, on Google Play!
